objective: Validate the Phase 2 AudioWorklet kernel on the real local Windows browser and physical audio device before promotion.
scope: Do not patch product or system code.
Write results only under reports/local-debug/** on validation/local-debug.
steps: Fetch the exact requested SHA and run python bootstrap.py; require LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Start the Vite development server with the repository's configured cross-origin-isolation headers.
Open the app in the normal local Chromium/Chrome-family browser used for testing.
Click Start audio kernel and confirm the 220 Hz diagnostic tone is audible and clean.
Record browser/version, Windows version, selected physical audio output device, context sample rate, baseLatency, outputLatency if exposed, renderQuantum, and frameDiscontinuities.
While tone is playing, deliberately stress/block the page main thread using the provided harness and verify audio remains continuous by listening.
Repeat start/stop at least 10 times and note clicks, gaps, failure to resume, or state mismatch.
Leave the tone running for at least 5 minutes while using the browser normally; report any audible dropout/glitch.
Capture before/after status snapshots for the stress interval and compute new frame discontinuities.

Write reports/local-debug/LATEST.json matching RESULT_SCHEMA.json, ENVIRONMENT.json, and SESSION_LOG.md on validation/local-debug; push the report branch so the runner-backed debug bus relays it to issue #1.
evidence_required: AudioContext sample rate, base latency, output latency when available, observed render quantum.
Before/after currentFrame and frameDiscontinuities around main-thread stress.
Audible assessment: clean tone / clicks / gaps / dropouts.
stop_conditions: If bootstrap fails, stop and report BLOCKED.
If the exact requested SHA cannot be checked out, stop and report BLOCKED.
If the browser cannot create/resume AudioContext or AudioWorklet, stop and report FAIL with console evidence.
Do not modify product/system code from validation/local-debug.
